edges.reason: tx.origin is used as the key to read and write the transfer delay timestamp mapping, allowing origin-based gating of transfers
block.timestamp is stored as the holder first buy timestamp and later compared to decide early sell tax

normalization_plan.reason: The from parameter only feeds the transfer override logic and carries no independent semantics beyond _transfer
The to parameter is only meaningful inside the transfer override logic of _transfer
The amount parameter is consumed exclusively by the fee and limit arithmetic in _transfer
The tokenAmount parameter is used only for approval and swapping inside swapTokensForEth
The ethAmount parameter is used only as the ETH value forwarded by addLiquidity
The recipients array is only iterated over inside the Chire airdrop loop
The values array is only indexed and scaled inside the Chire airdrop loop
The contractBalance local is a temporary snapshot used solely within swapBack
The totalTokensToSwap local aggregates fee buckets only for swapBack arithmetic
The ethForDev local is computed and immediately spent inside swapBack
The ethForLiquidity local is computed and immediately used inside swapBack
The newAmount parameter is validated and written only by updateSwapTokensAtAmount
